parameters.content:
### Input from WF1
Trigger entrypoint for seeds from Workflow 1.  
Receives Industry, Country, City, CityCountry, Row, CityIndex, NextIndustryRow, NextCityIndex.

### Init Quota Caps
Compute daily quota caps from monthly allowances (with safety margin).  
Outputs baseline caps for text, details, and geocode requests.

### Quota → Read (All)
Reads the entire Quota sheet to check past usage.  
Always output data to avoid empty pipeline breaks.

### Ensure Today (build)
Ensures a row for today's date exists in the Quota sheet.  
If missing, builds a zeroed record for today.

### Quota Ctx
Builds aggregated quota context for the run.  
Combines Init Quota Caps + today's row to calculate remaining budget.

### Gate Build (Quota ready)
Ensures Build queries only runs when quota context is ready.  
Input1 = Quota Ctx, Input2 = Return __control from WF1.

### Build queries
Generates search queries (variants per seed) with balanced quota usage.  
Infers Google PlaceType from industry and calculates per-page details cap.

### Prep Geocode Input
Prepares address string (City, Country) for geocoding.  
Adds language/region hints for API request.

### Geocode City
HTTP request to Google Geocode API.  
Fetches lat/lng for the given City, Country.

### Extract Geo
Parses geocode response.  
Validates status, extracts lat/lng, attaches to seed.

### Has Geo
Adds flag `hasGeo` if valid lat/lng exists.  
Used to branch IF: has geo.

### IF has geo
Routes items:  
- TRUE → Init PageCtx (continue to TextSearch).  
- FALSE → Skip TextSearch (no geo).

### IF has geo
Routes items:  
- TRUE → Init PageCtx (continue to TextSearch).  
- FALSE → Skip TextSearch (no geo).

### Skip TextSearch (no geo)
Pass-through with skip flag if no geocoordinates.  
Still allows pipeline continuity.

### Init PageCtx
Initialize pagination context for TextSearch (page=1, token=null).  
Ensures subsequent pagination works correctly.

### Force Query (test)
Optional debug node: forces query unchanged.  
Pass-through for testing variations.

### Places Text Search
HTTP request to Google Places TextSearch API.  
Search businesses with query + geo location, supports pagetoken.

### Merge PageCtx + Response
Merges request context with API response.  
Keeps pagination state.

### debug
Logs number of results and presence of next_page_token.  
For troubleshooting pagination.

### Paginate TextSearch
Splits TextSearch output into two routes:  
- `_route: this` → current page results.  
- `_route: next` → request for next page (if token exists).

### IF: This?
Filters items tagged `_route: this`.  
Sends them to Explode Search Results.

### IF: Next?
Filters items tagged `_route: next`.  
Sends them to Wait next before re-calling TextSearch.

### Wait next
Delays ~2.5s to let next_page_token activate.  
Then loops back into Places Text Search.

### Explode Search Results
Expands Places results into individual items.  
Adds seed context and caps items per query.

### count-tap
Debug node counting results after explode.  
Helps validate expected output size.

### Keep Unique by place_id
Filters duplicates by Google place_id.  
Ensures one unique record per place.

### count-tap-3
Debug node counting after uniqueness filter.  
Also routes into quota and batching nodes.

### Split in Batches (DetailsLoop)
Processes items in small batches for Place Details requests.  
Batch size 10 by default.

### Place Details
HTTP request to Google Places Details API.  
Fetches website, phone, url, rating, reviews.

### Wait
Short delay between Detail calls (~0.25s).  
Prevents hammering the API.

### Details Inspect
Checks Place Details response.  
Flags transient errors and sets `_needsRetry`.

### IF: Needs retry?
Routes items:  
- TRUE → Wait Retry + Bump Retry → retry Place Details.  
- FALSE → Guard Details Response.

### Wait Retry
Delay before retrying Place Details.  
Backoff increases per retry attempt.

### Bump Retry
Increments retry counter and sets backoff delay.  
Limits retries to MAX_RETRIES.

### Guard Details Response
Normalizes Place Details output.  
Ensures place_id, website, phone, url are promoted to top-level.

### quota only
Produces quota delta for details calls.  
Signals 1 unit of usage per Place Details.

### Merge Δ (Text+Details)
Combines TextSearch + Details results.  
Enrich mode: keep input1 (TextSearch), enrich with Details.

### Merge Δ (All)
Combines quota deltas (text, details, geocode).  
Feeds into Quota Δ Sum.

### Normalize (to Leads RAW)
Builds normalized record for RAW leads sheet.  
Extracts PlaceId, Name, Address, Website, Phone, Domain, etc.

### Quality flags & sanitize
Adds boolean flags and computes QualityScore.  
Flags: HasWebsite, HasPhone, IsSocialDomain, IsHostedSite, IsLikelyOwnSite.

### Dedupe PlaceId|Domain
Deduplicates leads by PlaceId or Domain.  
Ensures unique leads downstream.

### sanity-debug
Debug node printing counts of valid website/phone.  
Verifies filtering logic.

### Loop Over Items
Batch appender for RAW leads.  
One-by-one append to Google Sheet + wait.

### Append → Leads (RAW)
Appends normalized leads to RAW sheet.  
Auto-maps fields.

### Wait (RAW)
Delay between RAW writes (~3–4s).  
Loops back to Loop Over Items.

### Filter: has Website or Phone
Filters items for VALIDATED sheet.  
Policy toggle: requires Website (true) or Website OR Phone.

### Loop Over Items1
Batch appender for VALIDATED leads.  
Append one-by-one to Validated sheet + wait.

### Append → Leads (Validated)
Appends deduped + filtered leads to VALIDATED sheet.  
Upsert by PlaceId.

### Wait Validated
Delay between VALIDATED writes (~5–7s).  
Loops back to Loop Over Items1.

### Gate: Upsert after Validated done
Ensures quota updates only after Validated writes finish.  
Synchronizes quota pipeline.

### Quota Δ Geocode
Quota delta: +1 for each Geocode request.  
Feeds into Merge Δ (All).

### Quota Δ Sum
Aggregates all quota deltas (text, details, geocode).  
Prepares totals for today.

### Quota Totals
Combines Ensure Today baseline + quota deltas.  
Final usage counts for the day.

### Wait → Quota Upsert
Delay before quota upsert (~2–3s).  
Smooths API calls.

### Quota → Upsert1
Writes updated quota usage to Quota sheet.  
Upserts by Day column.

### Next Batch (Signal)
Lightweight completion signal emitted at the very end of W2.  
Purpose: unblock the upstream loop and allow the next seed/batch to start.
